overview.heading: 1. Overview
overview.bodyBefore: Your privacy is important to us. It is the policy of
overview.bodyAfter: ("SpexSol", "we", "us", "our") to respect your privacy and comply with any applicable law and regulation regarding any personal information we may collect about you, including across our website, mobile applications and other sites and services we own and operate. This policy applies to the SpexSol marketing site and to the iOS applications published by SpexSol.

collection.heading: 2. Information We Collect
collection.intro: Information we collect falls into one of two categories: "voluntarily provided" information and "automatically collected" information. Voluntarily provided information refers to any information you knowingly and actively provide us when using or participating in our services. Automatically collected information refers to any information automatically sent by your devices in the course of accessing our products and services.
collection.logDataBody: When you visit our website, our hosting provider may keep short-lived server access logs containing your IP address, user agent, the path requested and a timestamp. These logs are used solely to operate the service and to detect abuse or security incidents. Our iOS applications send crash and error diagnostics through Firebase Crashlytics; see section 9 (Cookies and Tracking Technologies) for details.
collection.personalIntro: We may ask for personal information — for example, when you contact us through the website or otherwise interact with our services. This may include:

items.03: Contents of any message you send us

collection.iosHeading: Data Collected by Our iOS Applications
collection.iosIntro: The data our iOS applications collect mirrors what is declared on each app's App Store privacy label. Unless stated otherwise for a specific application below, our applications do not require an account, do not use advertising identifiers, do not track you across other apps or websites, and do not request App Tracking Transparency permission or your location. The following subsections describe each application.

legitimateReasons.heading: 3. Legitimate Reasons for Processing Your Personal Information
legitimateReasons.body: We only collect and use your personal information when we have a legitimate reason for doing so. In which instance, we only collect personal information that is reasonably necessary to provide our services to you.

use.heading: 4. Collection and Use of Information
use.intro: We may collect, hold, use and disclose information for the following purposes, and personal information will not be further processed in a manner that is incompatible with these purposes:

items.01: to provide you with our platform's core features and services;
items.02: to enable you to contact us and to respond to your enquiries;
items.03: to comply with our legal obligations and resolve any disputes that we may have;
items.04: to improve and maintain the security and integrity of our services.

security.heading: 5. Security of Your Personal Information
security.body: When we collect and process personal information, and while we retain this information, we will protect it within commercially acceptable means to prevent loss and theft, as well as unauthorized access, disclosure, copying, use or modification. Although we will do our best to protect the personal information you provide to us, we advise that no method of electronic transmission or storage is 100% secure and no one can guarantee absolute data security.

retention.heading: 6. How Long We Keep Your Personal Information
paragraphs: We keep your personal information only for as long as we need to. Contact form submissions and any related correspondence are retained for up to 12 months after our last reply, after which they are deleted or anonymised. Server access logs are retained for the standard short window applied by our hosting provider. Crash and error reports submitted through Firebase Crashlytics are retained for Crashlytics' default period (90 days) unless they are tied to an open issue we are still investigating. Usage analytics events collected through Firebase Analytics are retained for 14 months. If your personal information is no longer required and we are not legally obliged to retain it, we will delete it or make it anonymous by removing all details that identify you.
retention.appsIntro: Retention periods specific to individual applications:

children.heading: 7. Children's Privacy
children.body: Our products and services are not directed at children. We do not knowingly collect personal information from children under the age of 16 (the digital consent age in Slovakia and most of the EU under Article 8 GDPR), or under the age of 13 in jurisdictions where that lower threshold applies. If we become aware that we have collected personal information from a child below the applicable age without verified parental consent, we will take steps to delete that information.

thirdParties.heading: 8. Disclosure of Personal Information to Third Parties
thirdParties.intro: We may disclose personal information to:

items.01: a parent, subsidiary or affiliate of our company;
items.02: third-party service providers for the purpose of enabling them to provide their services to us, including (but not limited to) IT service providers, hosting providers, analytics providers, error loggers, and customer support providers;
items.03: courts, tribunals, regulatory authorities, and law enforcement officers, as required by law, in connection with any actual or prospective legal proceedings, or in order to establish, exercise, or defend our legal rights.

thirdParties.providersIntro: Third-party services we currently use or rely on include:

providers.01: Google Cloud Platform (Google Ireland Limited) — hosting for our application servers, databases and photo storage (Cloud Run, Cloud Firestore, Cloud Storage), located in the europe-west1 (Belgium) region. Processor.
providers.02: Firebase Crashlytics and Firebase Analytics (Google Ireland Limited) — crash reporting and anonymous usage analytics for our iOS applications. Minimal device and diagnostic data is processed on our behalf as a processor. Data may be transferred to the United States under the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses.
providers.03: Firebase App Check (Google Ireland Limited) and Apple App Attest (Apple Inc.) — device attestation that protects our servers from abuse.
providers.04: Anthropic, PBC (United States) — AI model provider for AI features in our applications (for example plant identification in Water Me). Receives the content you submit to the feature, processes it to return a result, and does not use it to train models. Transfers to the United States are covered by the European Commission's Standard Contractual Clauses included in Anthropic's data processing addendum.
providers.05: RevenueCat, Inc. (United States) — in-app subscription management. Receives your install identifier and App Store receipt to determine your subscription status. Standard Contractual Clauses apply.
providers.06: Apple Inc. — processes all payments, billing and refunds for in-app purchases under your Apple ID terms.
providers.07: Google Analytics 4 and Google Tag Manager (Google Ireland Limited) — measurement of website traffic. Loaded only after you accept analytics cookies via our cookie banner.
providers.08: Slack Technologies, LLC (United States) — delivery of website contact-form submissions to our internal workspace. Receives the name, email address and message you submit. Standard Contractual Clauses apply.

thirdParties.providersNote: This list is maintained on a best-effort basis and is updated when our integrations change.

cookies.heading: 9. Cookies and Tracking Technologies
cookies.body: Our marketing website uses Google Tag Manager and Google Analytics 4 (measurement ID G-BTY6T00NQ0) to understand how visitors use the site. These tools are loaded with Google Consent Mode v2 set to "denied" by default and are only activated after you accept analytics cookies via our cookie banner. You can change or withdraw your consent at any time using the "Cookie Settings" link in the footer. If you reject analytics cookies, no analytics or advertising cookies are set and no measurement data is sent. The only other automatically collected data is the short-lived server access log described in section 2, kept by our hosting provider for security and abuse prevention. Our iOS applications use Firebase Crashlytics for crash and error reporting and Firebase Analytics for anonymous usage statistics; they do not use advertising identifiers, do not track you across other apps or websites, and do not request App Tracking Transparency permission.

rights.heading: 10. Your Rights and Controlling Your Personal Information
rights.intro: You always retain the right to withhold personal information from us, with the understanding that your experience of our services may be affected. We will not discriminate against you for exercising any of your rights over your personal information. If you do provide us with personal information, you understand that we will collect, hold, use and disclose it in accordance with this privacy policy. You have the right to:

items.01: request access to the personal information we hold about you;
items.02: request that any inaccurate or out-of-date personal information be corrected;
items.03: unsubscribe from any direct marketing communications at any time;
items.04: request that we delete personal information we hold about you, subject to applicable legal requirements.

rights.outro: Where an application stores your data only on your device, deleting the app deletes that data. Data you have uploaded through a share link is deleted when you delete the share in the app or when it expires. For any other request, contact us at skalicky@spexsol.sk.

businessTransfers.heading: 11. Business Transfers
businessTransfers.body: If we or our assets are acquired, or in the unlikely event that we go out of business or enter bankruptcy, we would include data, including your personal information, among the assets transferred to any parties who acquire us. You acknowledge that such transfers may occur, and that any parties who acquire us may, to the extent permitted by applicable law, continue to use your personal information according to this policy.

limits.heading: 12. Limits of Our Policy
limits.body: Our website and applications may link to external sites that are not operated by us. Please be aware that we have no control over the content and policies of those sites, and cannot accept responsibility or liability for their respective privacy practices.

changes.heading: 13. Changes to This Policy
changes.body: At our discretion, we may change our privacy policy to reflect updates to our business processes, current acceptable practices, or legislative or regulatory changes. If we decide to change this privacy policy, we will post the changes here at the same link by which you are accessing this privacy policy and update the "Last updated" date at the top of this page.

gdpr.heading: 14. Additional Disclosures for GDPR Compliance (EU)
gdpr.controllerBody: SpexSol s. r. o. acts as a data controller in respect of the personal information we collect from users in the European Economic Area (EEA) and the United Kingdom.
gdpr.legalBasesIntro: We will process your personal information lawfully, fairly and in a transparent manner. We collect and process information about you only where we have legal bases for doing so. These legal bases depend on the services you use and how you use them, meaning we collect and use your information only where:

legalBases.01: it is necessary for the performance of a contract to which you are a party or to take steps at your request before entering into such a contract (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR) — for example, when we respond to an enquiry you submit through the contact form — and when we process content you submit to an AI feature or data you choose to publish through a share link, as these are features you actively request;
legalBases.02: it satisfies a legitimate interest (which is not overridden by your data protection interests) under Article 6(1)(f) GDPR, such as responding to enquiries that are not pre-contractual, keeping our iOS applications stable and secure through crash reporting, understanding which features are used through anonymous analytics, protecting our services from abuse, and protecting our legal rights and interests;
legalBases.03: you give us consent to do so for a specific purpose under Article 6(1)(a) GDPR; or
legalBases.04: we need to process your data to comply with a legal obligation under Article 6(1)(c) GDPR.

gdpr.transfersBody: We will ensure that any transfer of personal information from countries in the European Economic Area (EEA) to countries outside the EEA is protected by appropriate safeguards, for example by using Standard Contractual Clauses approved by the European Commission. This applies in particular to crash, error and usage data sent to Firebase, content sent to Anthropic for AI features, purchase data sent to RevenueCat, contact-form submissions delivered through Slack, and website analytics data sent to Google Analytics, all of which may be processed in the United States.
gdpr.dpoBody: We have not appointed a Data Protection Officer. Given the size of SpexSol and the limited nature of the personal data we process, we are not required to do so under Article 37 GDPR. For any questions relating to your personal data you can contact us directly at skalicky@spexsol.sk.
gdpr.rightsIntro: In addition to the rights listed in section 10, you have the right to:

rights.01: restrict the processing of your personal information;
rights.02: object to the processing of your personal information;
rights.03: request the portability of your personal information;
rights.04: lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority — in Slovakia, the Office for Personal Data Protection of the Slovak Republic (Úrad na ochranu osobných údajov Slovenskej republiky), dataprotection.gov.sk.

ccpa.heading: 15. Additional Disclosures for California Compliance (US)
ccpa.dntBody: Some browsers have a "Do Not Track" feature that lets you tell websites that you do not want to have your online activities tracked. At this time, we do not respond to browser "Do Not Track" signals.
ccpa.noticeBody: In the past 12 months, we have collected the following categories of personal information enumerated in the California Consumer Privacy Act: identifiers (such as name, email address and IP address) and internet or other electronic network activity information (such as browsing history and information regarding interaction with our services). We collect this information for the business purposes described in this policy.
ccpa.rightsBody: If you are a California resident, you have the right to know what personal information we collect about you, to request deletion of your personal information, and to not be discriminated against for exercising these rights. To exercise any of these rights, please contact us using the details below.
ccpa.shineBody: If you are a California resident, in addition to the rights discussed above, you have the right to request information from us regarding the manner in which we share certain personal information with third parties for their direct marketing purposes.

waterMe.name: Water Me
waterMe.collectionIntro: Water Me stores your plants, photos, watering history, reminders and settings locally on your device. Reminders are scheduled on the device itself; no notification data leaves it. The following data does leave the device:

collectionItems.01: Crash and performance diagnostics — sent to Firebase Crashlytics (see section 9).
collectionItems.02: Usage analytics — anonymous in-app events (for example "plant added", "reminder snoozed", "paywall shown") and screen views, sent to Firebase Analytics so we can understand which features are used. The vendor identifier and advertising identifier are not collected.
collectionItems.03: Install identifier — a random identifier generated on first launch. It is sent with requests to our server to enforce fair-use limits and to recognise your purchases. It is not linked to your name, email or Apple ID.
collectionItems.04: Plant photos for AI identification (Premium) — when you tap "Identify" on a photo, a reduced-size copy of that photo is sent to our server and forwarded to Anthropic's Claude API, which returns the species and care suggestions. We do not store the photo or the result on our servers; Anthropic does not use API data to train its models. The result is stored only on your device.
collectionItems.05: Shared plant lists — if you create a share link, the data you choose to share (your display name, plant and container names, plant and container photos, watering schedules and the watering log) is uploaded to our servers so that people with the link can view it and, unless you mark the share read-only, record waterings. See section 8 for storage and retention.
collectionItems.06: Purchase status — when you buy or restore Premium, our subscription provider RevenueCat receives your install identifier and the purchase receipt from Apple. We never see your payment details.
collectionItems.07: Device attestation — each request to our server carries a Firebase App Check token, obtained from Apple's App Attest service, which proves the request comes from a genuine copy of the app.

retention: Shared plant lists. A share lives for the period you choose when creating it (at most 365 days) and is deleted automatically seven days after it expires. You can delete a share at any time from the app, which removes all its data, including photos, from our servers immediately. Links to shared photos expire one hour after they are issued. If you no longer have access to the device that created a share, email us the share code and we will delete it.

Photos submitted for AI identification are processed in memory and discarded once the result is returned; we do not retain them. Rate-limit counters keyed by your install identifier are deleted automatically after one day (Premium) or one month (free tier). Your install identifier itself is removed when you delete the app.

acceptance.body: These Terms form a binding agreement between you and SpexSol. We may update them from time to time; the version published on this page is always the one in force. Continuing to use the services after an update means you accept the revised Terms.

useOfService.heading: 2. Use of the Service
useOfService.intro: SpexSol is provided for personal and professional use in line with applicable law. You are responsible for how you use it.

items.01: You must be at least 16 years old, or the minimum age required in your jurisdiction, to use the services on your own behalf.

accounts.heading: 3. Accounts
accounts.body: Some of our services may currently be used without an account. In the future, certain features may require you to create an account. If and when you create one, you agree to provide accurate information, to keep your credentials confidential, and to be responsible for all activity that takes place under your account. You must notify us promptly of any unauthorised use. We may suspend or terminate accounts that breach these Terms.

subscriptions.heading: 4. Paid Subscriptions and In-App Purchases
paragraphs: Some features of our iOS applications are offered as paid subscriptions or in-app purchases. All payments, billing, renewals, and refunds for purchases made through the App Store are processed by Apple in accordance with the terms of your Apple ID account, and not by SpexSol.

Subscriptions automatically renew unless auto-renewal is turned off at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. You can manage and cancel subscriptions in your Apple ID account settings. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current billing period; previously charged amounts are non-refundable except where required by law or by Apple's policies.
Prices, features, and the scope of free and paid tiers may change. Where required, we will notify you of material changes before they take effect.

Subscriptions and in-app purchases are tied to the Apple ID used for the purchase and are available on all your devices signed in with that Apple ID. Use "Restore purchases" in the app's settings to re-activate them on a new or reinstalled device.

aiFeatures.heading: 5. AI-Assisted Features
aiFeatures.body: Some of our applications offer features powered by third-party artificial intelligence models, such as identifying a plant species from a photo and suggesting a watering schedule. These results are generated automatically and may be inaccurate or incomplete. They are provided for general informational purposes only and are not professional horticultural, veterinary, medical or toxicity advice. Always verify a plant's identity and safety independently, especially where children, pets or allergies are concerned. SpexSol is not liable for any loss arising from reliance on AI-generated results. AI features may be subject to fair-use limits and may be changed or withdrawn at any time.

sharing.heading: 6. Sharing Features
sharing.body: Some applications let you share content (such as a list of plants and their photos) with other people through a link. Anyone who has the link can view the shared content and, unless you mark the share read-only, add entries to it. You are responsible for whom you give the link to and for making sure you have the right to share any content it contains, including photos. You can end a share at any time from within the app. Shares end automatically on the expiry date you set. We may remove shared content that violates these Terms or applicable law.
